mapper.sql: SELECT D.ID AS "id" ,D.CODE AS "code" ,D.HOST_ID AS "hostId" ,H.NICKNAME AS "hostName" ,D.GUEST_ID AS "guestId" ,G.NICKNAME AS "guestName" ,D.STATUS AS "status" ,TO_CHAR(D.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate" ,TO_CHAR(D.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endDate" ,D.HOST_SCORE AS "hostScore" ,D.GUEST_SCORE AS "guestScore" ,D.WINNER_ID AS "winnerId" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM D.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" FROM T_DUEL D JOIN T_USER H ON H.ID = D.HOST_ID LEFT JOIN T_USER G ON G.ID = D.GUEST_ID
mapper.select: WHERE 1=1 AND (D.HOST_ID = #{userId} OR D.GUEST_ID = #{userId}) AND NOT (D.STATUS = 'EXPIRED' AND D.GUEST_ID IS NULL AND D.INS_DAY < NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days') ORDER BY D.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_DUEL WHERE 1=1 AND (HOST_ID = #{userId} OR GUEST_ID = #{userId}) AND STATUS IN ('WAITING', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE T_DUEL SET STATUS = 'EXPIRED' ,UPD_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND CODE = #{code} AND HOST_ID = #{hostId} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
mapper.select: WHERE 1=1 AND D.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND D.END_DATE < #{today} ORDER BY D.ID
mapper.update: UPDATE T_DUEL SET STATUS = 'EXPIRED' ,UPD_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'WAITING' AND INS_DAY < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days'
